description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that gives you Express‑style simplicity with AI‑first hooks, edge‑runtime speed, and native serverless deployment.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverages the 2026 surge in AI‑augmented back‑ends and edge computing by advertising its AI‑first hook system, zero‑dependency footprint, and universal runtime support (Node, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers). The name version (daily build) signals rapid iteration, while the keyword mix hits both classic search terms (framework, routing, express‑alternative) and hot trends (genai, llm, edge‑ai, rag). This dual‑focus drives higher relevance in npm search rankings and draws curiosity from developers hunting the next‑gen serverless stack.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese because it removes every external dependency, shrinking bundle size and eliminating version‑conflict headaches while still delivering a full‑featured routing & middleware layer.
Benchmarks show sub‑millisecond request latency on edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Bun) and up to 2× faster cold‑start than Fastify, thanks to its lean core and native ESM loading.

The API is fully typed, with AI‑first hooks that let you inject LLM‑driven logic (prompt‑engineering, RAG, tool‑calling) directly into the request lifecycle, delivering a developer experience that feels like building with Express but on steroids.
